label: Majorero
note: Cured versions may include up to 15 % Canarian sheep milk; rind left natural or rubbed with oil, paprika or toasted gofio; edges show the imprint of the palm-leaf braid mould.

about.text: Majorero is a firm, pale goat milk cheese from the island of Fuerteventura in the Canary Islands, made from the milk of the Majorera goat. It has PDO status and is sold with a natural, oiled, paprika or gofio rind.
